players.product: multi-beam and single-beam electron-beam mask writers and spot-beam electron-beam lithography systems (Industrial Equipment); TEM / FIB systems for semiconductor inspection

quarterly_data.signal: Product launch (NMR): SuperCOOL MARVEL HFX Duo, a double- or triple-resonance auto-switched high-sensitivity liquid-nitrogen-cooled NMR probe for 19F-containing compounds, released on September 2, 2026 with sales scheduled to begin in September 2026; it enables 1H/19F/X triple-resonance measurement on a 2ch spectrometer and has more than 2.6 times the sensitivity of JEOL's room-temperature ROYALPROBE HFX probe for 13C measurements at 600 MHz.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 2.6 times the sensitivity (13C at 600 MHz); sales from September 2026
